correctness.rationale: The fixed Klein model is smooth over F5 by its partials; the Hessian is X^5Z+XY^5+YZ^5. The three coordinate flexes plus reversible elimination in the affine chart yield exactly the 21 roots of a square-free degree-21 polynomial, with no denominator poles. Exact finite-field factorization is 3+6+6+6, and exact tangent-Jacobian determinants are units in all four quotient fields. Every point is reduced, so no inflection points are omitted. The residual tangent map is computed by exact polynomial coefficient extraction; tau has order three, no fixed points, and maps the three sextic root orbits cyclically. Frobenius therefore acts on the 24 flexes as 1^3 3^1 6^3 and on their eight triangles as 1^2 6^1. Closed-point orbit formulas yield all rational counts and zeta functions. VERIFY.py replays certificates with Python integer polynomial arithmetic.

originality.rationale: Elkies' geometric 24-flex discussion and the Poonen--Schaefer--Stoll eight flex-triangle construction are acknowledged and not asserted new. The new assertion is the explicit Frobenius cycle types 1^3 3^1 6^3 and 1^2 6^1 on the standard characteristic-five model, and their induced exact rational-point and finite-scheme zeta formulas. Those arithmetic splitting statements were not found in the identified relevant primary text or in targeted indexed searches. value.rationale: The 24-flex divisor is canonical for the Klein plane quartic and the eight tangent-successor triangles enter arithmetic descent constructions. Determining their actual Frobenius splitting at the first tame prime five is a natural field-of-definition invariant; two rational flex triangles do not mean six rational flex points, a substantive descent distinction. The exact orbit and zeta formulas classify both natural finite schemes over all finite extensions, rather than an arbitrary isolated count.
